notes.content:
Update 1.0.3 has been released:

[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
The Custom Update has been released. Note: Old save files may become corrupted.

[list]
[*] Added Skins
[*] Added Premium Weapons
[*] Changed Astropomancer and Mathematician classes.
[*] Bug Fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Update 1.0.1 is out with some new features and some bug fixes:

[list]
[*] New Faction: Control
[*] 6 New Classes
[*] Enemy levels and difficulty select
[*] Spy special abilities changed
[*] Dialogue changes
[*] Special moves balanced
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]
